title: What are the next two rows of the half roti table?
description: The table of half rotis grows by one more half in each row. Two more rows are added after the fifth row, and each new row is checked against the row before it.
teaching_notes: One idea: each new row of the table adds one more of the same fractional unit. Watch for students who change the unit or add two halves at a time.

source: Continue this table of 1/2 for 2 more steps.
video_script.why: The child extends the table of half rotis by adding one more half to the last row, twice, and writes each new row as a number of times one half.
video_script.substitution: Treat each new row as the row before with one more half roti added.
video_script.anchor: A table of half rotis with five rows, each row one half roti longer than the one before, and two empty rows below
video_script.payoff_line: Each new row adds one more half

final_answer.spoken: six halves added are six times half, and seven halves added are seven times half

video_script.fraction_reading: one half, six halves, seven halves
never_show: 6 x 1/2 and 7 x 1/2 before the answer beat
maths_rules: the last row of the table has 5 halves: 1/2 + 1/2 + 1/2 + 1/2 + 1/2 = 5 x 1/2
adding one more 1/2 gives the next row: 6 halves added = 6 x 1/2
adding one more 1/2 again gives the row after: 7 halves added = 7 x 1/2
check: each new row has exactly one more half than the row before it
video_script.design: One idea: add one more half to the last row to get the next row. Same method as the table of five rows. The table and the two empty rows stay on the board to the end.
